gaps.sentence: The economy showed further ___ (WEAK) in the third quarter.
gaps.explanation: 'Further weakness' — the noun form follows the adjective 'further'.

gaps.sentence: The shop is under new ___ (MANAGE) from Monday.
You will need written ___ (PERMIT) to enter the site.
gaps.explanation: 'Written permission' — the noun you can be given in writing.

gaps.sentence: The trainers were ___ (COMFORT) for long walks.
gaps.explanation: 'Were comfortable' — adjective; note the spelling: -able, not -ible.

gaps.sentence: The hotel is ___ (CONVENIENT) situated near the station.
gaps.explanation: 'Conveniently situated' — the adverb modifies the participle.

gaps.sentence: The economy shows signs of ___ (RECOVER) after the recession.

gaps.explanation: 'Optimistic' is the adjective; 'optimism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
